bio.text: Jason Nazarenko represents District 4 in the Arkansas House of Representatives, which includes parts of Marion and Baxter counties, and is serving his first term.

The House says Nazarenko retired from a military career that included service in Egypt, Korea, Iraq and Afghanistan, and that he was a Blackhawk helicopter pilot and served nearly a decade with the 160th Special Operations Aviation Regiment.
He is a small business owner and president of the Cotter-Gassville Chamber of Commerce, and lives in Cotter.
